evidence.title: Terms of Use — Forma Icon Creator

name: Forma Icon Creator
summary: Browser icon designer that styles Tabler, Lucide, Phosphor, Iconoir and Heroicons icons and exports them as SVG or PNG.
description: Free browser-based editor for app icons: pick an icon from supported open-source libraries, customise colors, size, stroke and effects, then export individual SVG or PNG files. A Premium plan ($9/month) or Lifetime purchase ($36 once) unlocks ZIP export of a whole styled library, limited to 10 exports per rolling hour and up to 7,200 library downloads per 30-day month.
contains: design and export individual icons for free
